execute_js.body: () => { const nav=document.querySelector('nav[aria-label="Main navigation"]'); const buttons=[...nav.querySelectorAll('button')]; const all=buttons.find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='All projects'); return {textCreateRemoved:!buttons.some(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='Create project'),plusPresent:!!nav.querySelector('[aria-label="Create project"]'),fontSize:getComputedStyle(all).fontSize}; }
